text_block_list.text:
One day, a while after finishing those crucial
first three years in the Twinkle Series.

Using the hot springs trip voucher won earlier,
we had arrived on our hot springs vacation!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. Before we arrive,
there's something I'd like to suggest...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"C-Can...
Can I talk to you casually?!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um... When I won the raffle, I mentioned that I wanted to get to know you better during this trip, Trainer... remember?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I feel like Trainer-san and I
have gotten super close over these past three years!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Still, how should I put it—
I just felt like it'd be wonderful if we could
get to know each other even better!"
choice_data_list: I see... And that's why you're dropping the formalities?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! Don't you think tearing down the walls between our stations might lead to new discoveries?
Why would she want to know more now of all times...? Setting that question aside, since we're on a trip anyway, I'd like to grant her wish if she desires it so badly.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-We're here at the hot springs resort!
I'm so looking forward to it—I mean, yeah~!
choice_data_list: A-Ah! I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
F-First, let's look up where the hot springs ar... okay!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I-I'm the one who brought it up,
but this is so... hard to talk about!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Still, Trainer seems to be pumping themselves up
to match my energy.
I've got to get used to it somehow...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah, this steamed bun is delicious...!
It's so chewy and fluffy—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Would you like to try some too, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ............Wanna try a bite!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*.
So warm...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...A casual comment, without honorifics.
Casual comment, without honorifics――)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Ummm.
Ah............ it's so waaaarm!"

Far from "getting to know each other,"
time simply passed without them even having
a proper conversation—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...The bath wa-- felt great!
Uh, umm..."

"...I appreciate the sentiment, but...
this is only going to make things harder for Dantsu Flame."
choice_data_list: How about we take a break from the casual talk for a bit?
How about we take a break from the casual talk for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes, you're right!
Sorry about that~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Aargh.
I totally messed up...)

Afterward,
we decided to go for a walk until mealtime.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Look at all these stars!
They're so pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (......Ah. Trainer squints their eyes whenever they look up at the stars.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (......I feel like I'm finally able to take a proper look at Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I was way too distracted to pay attention before.
What a waste...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "...Um, I'm sorry for making such a weird suggestion today."
choice_data_list: Huh? No, no, I really appreciated the thought!

text_block_list.text: —However, why she still believed they needed to get to know each other better remained unclear in the end.
Through getting to know each other over these three years, I felt that our relationship had reached a culmination.

Still, to Dants Flame,
perhaps it felt like just another step on her journey.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No! I feel the same way.
The same as you, Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: If anything, that's why—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I-I just wanted to make sure...!
It wouldn't collapse!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if something happens and we're separated,
I hope we can keep writing letters to each other forever."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"A relationship where we can meet up once in a while...
and talk just like we do now—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I never, ever wanted things to change...
Especially not between you and me, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So, I thought that as long as I didn't stop...
nothing would have to change.
I only wish I could have done it better.
—It finally makes sense.

For Dantsu Flame,
building such a strong bond of trust
was a first.
choice_data_list: ...If we're ever apart, I'll write you letters.
...If we're ever apart, I'll write you letters.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: We'll meet up and talk from time to time, and stay good friends forever.

text_block_list.text:
To begin with, I can't even imagine
a day when we'd part ways now.
choice_data_list: Always and forever. You're my special Umamusume.
Always and forever. You're my special Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...R-Really...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...W-Wahâ

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank goodness.
............Thank goodness.

Under the starlight,
Dantsu Flame smiled peacefully.

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Dantsu Flame...
